tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Return complete structured metadata for one resource: descriptions (EN/AZ), capabilities, tools, transports, auth, packages, compatibility, pricing, security profile, quality signals (stars, last commit), installation and links. Accepts a slug, numeric id, exact name, ABCommunity page URL or GitHub

No subjective winner is chosen. Accepts slugs, ids, names or GitHub owner/repo; unknown referenc

tools.name: get_catalog_overview
tools.description: List what the ABCommunity catalog contains and the exact values its filters accept: resource types with counts, categories, the capability taxonomy (keys such as email.read, database.query, browser.automate with access type and risk), platforms, pricing values and the most recently added resources.

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Understand a project idea or repo summary and return product type, stack, stage, modules, risks, and open questions.

tools.name: plan_project_sprints
tools.description: Break a project into execution-ready sprints with tasks, acceptance criteria, risks, and next actions.

tools.name: map_resources_to_project
tools.description: Explain which ABCommunity resources apply to a project, when to use them, how to apply them, and what config/risk is involved.

tools.name: recommend_resources_for_sprint
tools.description: Recommend MCPs, skills, tools, APIs, and frameworks for one sprint in a project roadmap.

tools.name: generate_agent_blueprint
tools.description: Create role-specific agent instructions for a project sprint or area.

tools.name: generate_config_bundle
tools.description: Create safe client-specific MCP config notes, env checklist, install steps, and verification steps for selected resources.

tools.name: get_next_project_action
tools.description: Return the next most useful action for a project based on its sprint roadmap and current state.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_resources, find_mcp_for_task, recommend_stack, get_resource, get_catalog_overview · Private data: get_catalog_overview · Public sink: find_mcp_for_task, recommend_stack, get_catalog_overview.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_resources, find_mcp_for_task, recommend_stack, get_resource, get_catalog_overview · Private data: get_catalog_overview · Public sink: find_mcp_for_task, recommend_stack, get_catalog_overview

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
